race.description: Myracehorse-The Wyong Horse Bundle Cond Hcp (Bm68)
race.comment: SOCIABLE (4) big jump in class when he floundered in the heavy going third-up to finish fourth behind Zouripper over 1000m at Randwick tin BM78 grade. Back to his right grade and both wins have come on good tracks. Go close. TURNING CIRCLE (10) fresh for this after an all-the-way win over this trip at Newcastle in similar class. Gets a much better set-up and shapes as a leading contender. CUBAN CIGAR (2) underrated gelding resuming. Went out a winner with a dominant performance over 1300m at Kembla Grange. Fitted with the two trials and has the class to test the leading division. STABILITY (6) chasing his third straight victory after gapping his rivals in the heavy going over 1200m at Gosford. Maps well and stays in the mix.
